java_locations.role: Uses the same letters, numbers, underscore and dot endpoint token for both sides, cleans it, and resolves or creates the corresponding contextual quark.
Creates a named-note quark from a CODE token that admits the same dotted and Unicode identity alphabet.
Normalizes endpoint spelling before contextual quark reuse without converting dots into display text.

rust_locations.role: Already admits letters, numbers, underscores and dots for named-note identity.
Restricts bare relation endpoints to `\w+`, so a code accepted by the note command cannot be consumed by the later relation command.

claimed_invariant: Component/Description relation endpoints and named-note codes share one bare identity token: one or more Unicode letters, Unicode numbers, underscores or dots. A later CommandLinkElement relation reuses the exact named-note quark on either endpoint side and in the current package context; it does not create a component or interface for that code. The same endpoint grammar remains available for ordinary declared and undeclared description leaves.
causal_divergence: Rust independently encoded the two command grammars. The shared named-note parser was widened to Java's CODE alphabet, but RE_DESCRIPTION_CONN retained its older `\w+` alternatives. Dotted note relations therefore fail recognition before known_note_ids can prevent synthetic endpoint creation or preserve relation UID order.
planned_model_change: Construct both bare endpoint alternatives in RE_DESCRIPTION_CONN from the same NAMED_NOTE_CODE_PATTERN constant used by named-note commands. Preserve bracketed and quoted endpoint alternatives and all existing capture positions. Add parser evidence that dotted and Unicode named notes are reused on both sides and that a same-token undeclared endpoint still follows ordinary CommandLinkElement materialization semantics.
perturbation_axes: ASCII dotted versus Unicode dotted code
declared note reuse versus undeclared endpoint materialization
acceptance: The five preserved valid Component counterexamples in command-factory-note-grammar retain their named-note relation events without synthetic leaves.
Fresh dotted and Unicode note codes work on either relation side and preserve package-qualified note ownership.
Undeclared dotted endpoints remain valid ordinary CommandLinkElement identities rather than becoming note-specific exceptions.
Existing bracketed, quoted and plain ASCII Component relation tests remain green.
An independent checker attacks token alphabet, endpoint side, ownership, direction and undeclared controls.
forbidden_approaches: special-casing known note IDs after a failed relation regex
rewriting dots or Unicode to fixture-specific ASCII aliases
creating a second note-only relation parser
keying behavior to Component.Memo_7, SimpleMemo or reviewed labels
declared_residue: Parenthesis, interface-eye, colon-delimited and other CommandLinkElement endpoint syntaxes outside the letters/numbers/underscore/dot token remain separate parser mechanisms.
Java UGroup SVG metadata sanitization of Unicode identity is a separate serialization mechanism recorded by the endpoint checker.
Generic Component layout and edge-coordinate differences are outside this parser identity mechanism.
